runtime_pool_policy.execution_deadline: max(fee window, buy cooldown multiplied by batch count)
runtime_pool_policy.external_buy_activation: preposition after mined TokenLaunched log; earliest legal inclusion is the following block

limitations: ClockIn final mainnet Factory, creator, CA and pool configuration are not yet in the public official address table.

The current public Launcher preview describes a separate 99-minute, 99-percent Safe Launch; this adapter remains authorized only for the discussed ClockIn initial fee at or below 4000 bps and will reject that public preview mechanism.
Factory address and runtime code hash are required at startup and are never inferred by name scanning.
The Robinhood Nitro Sequencer Feed decoder is not implemented because no stable application-layer transaction schema is published for this client.

The official direct Sequencer is write-only for this client, so chain identity is bound by its exact official HTTPS hostname plus chain ID 4663 in every signed transaction; an invalid empty payload probes method availability at startup.
The live adapter supports only payable native-ETH buy(uint256,bytes32); ERC-20 quote pools fail closed.
minTokensOut defaults to one raw token unit under the explicitly small 5U speed-first risk budget.
No real transaction has been broadcast and no live receipt exists.
Automatic sell or executable-exit validation is not implemented.

evidence.claim: Configured production HTTP returned Robinhood chain ID 4663, block 37151071 and an EIP-1559 base fee; authenticated WSS emitted block 37151073 through newHeads. No signing or broadcast method was called.
The configured authenticated WSS endpoint accepted a standard exact-address/topic eth_subscribe logs request. No signing or broadcast method was called.

Robinhood's official direct Sequencer exposed eth_sendRawTransaction and deterministically rejected the invalid empty probe as typed transaction too short. No private key, signed transaction or valid transaction was sent.

70 local tests cover exact TokenLaunched topic decoding, Factory code-hash drift, subscribe-before-backfill discovery, identity rejection, 99-percent mechanism rejection, official CA confirmation/mismatch, pool ABI reads, cooldown and dual authorization scheduling, staged dynamic signing, direct Sequencer probing, resilient broadcast-route degradation, same-raw fanout, UNKNOWN rebroadcast, receipt-gated sequential nonce use, token delivery reconciliation, recovery and wallet locking.
